items.question: Which institution operates the work readiness programme for UAE national inmates in the UAE correctional facilities rehabilitation service?
items.gold: The Higher Colleges of Technology operates the work readiness programme.
items.fact: Higher Colleges of Technology operates inmate work readiness programme

items.question: Are UAE correctional facilities subject to random visits from human rights departments and public prosecutors?
items.gold: Yes, the facilities are subject to random visits from human rights departments and public prosecutors.
items.fact: Correctional facilities receive random visits from human rights departments
